decision.reasoning_trace: I am looking for a reliable, general-purpose backpack and considered a range of options from lightweight daypacks to heavy-duty tactical rucksacks. The Maxpedition options (prod_backpacks_038 and prod_backpacks_096) are clearly high quality but come at a significantly higher price point. The W WINTMING tactical pack (prod_backpacks_164) offers great storage but had a concerning review regarding a broken buckle. The N NEVO RHINO (prod_backpacks_150) hydration pack is interesting but seems to have material noise and bladder durability issues. Ultimately, I selected the HIKPRO 20L (prod_backpacks_006) as it has the highest average rating (4.7), is very affordable, and the reviews consistently praise its durability and functionality as a packable daypack.
